rule: practice-snapshot gate: a test / reserved instruction that is a fragment of a validated practice row's own pinned instruction is exempt inside the free-text fields of A30-valid rows when nothing else leaks there; the registered gate runs first and again
recovery: practice-k3-v1: journal rows 1-9 and the verified row-9 checkpoint are kept; attempt 10 is repeated on resume; its four earlier executions (the first run and three launcher retries, each from the row-9 checkpoint, each stopped by the gate at the K = 10 snapshot) are discarded and disclosed with their logs; the failed K = 10 snapshot and the logs are archived before the overwrite; no practice is re-run to change wording; a snapshot that already passed the registered gate is not regenerated.
said: The practice-memory leakage gate refused Kitchen 3's snapshot because Opus's reply in practice attempt 8 echoed 'slice the bread' (a piece of that practice instruction, which is also a test sentence). How should this be handled? -> Own-fragment rule (Recommended)
